title: factory deploy's output and D1 record call the ticfac version "tk"
body: internal/factory/deploy.go stages the bundle printing "bundle <sha> (tk <version>)" and recordDeployment stores opts.Version — the TICFAC version — into a D1 column named tk_version (migrations/0002, carried unchanged from the ticks-era worker). Since the deploying binary is ticfac, the operator-facing line and the column name mislabel what they report; the wrangler.toml comment still says "`tk factory deploy` rewrites database_id". Cosmetic-to-low impact, but it is exactly the kind of legacy naming the move exists to retire, and the D1 column name is deploy-visible.
